shared_elements: low-relief figural signs arranged in rows
justification: Both surfaces present profile animals (quadrupeds, birds) and human figures carved in low relief and organised into horizontal registers, with a row of repeated animal forms along an upper band in A loosely echoing the rows of small animal and bird signs in B. But B's content is overwhelmingly a dense grid of small repeated sign-like elements with a figural scene confined to the lowest register, while A shows a few large, isolated, sculpturally massive creatures (a snarling quadruped, a serpent, a bird) with no sign-system character; the manner of rendering (bold plastic modelling versus fine, uniform, standardised miniature signs) is quite different.
